title: Astronomical configuration version 1
description: Instance policy and optional per-model preferences for Astronomical.

$schema.description: Relative path to the offline schema written beside this configuration.

schema_version.description: Persisted configuration format version used for one-way migration.

models.description: Optional preferences keyed by canonical requestable discovered model ID.

runtime.description: Instance-wide model discovery and MLX memory policy.

model_directories.description: Absolute directories recursively scanned for supported model artifacts.

maximum_mlx_memory_gb.description: Optional MLX memory ceiling in decimal SI gigabytes; omission selects the machine maximum.

experimental_qwen_thinking_channel_seed_.description: Whether Qwen requests may use the optional instance-state thinking.md seed.

enabled.description: Whether Astronomical may read and write the SSD-backed prompt cache.

maximum_size_gb.description: Global prompt-cache capacity in decimal SI gigabytes.

chunking.description: Advanced execution boundaries. Model values override only properties explicitly present here.

fixed_prompt_processing_chunk_size_token.description: Maximum ordinary prompt-processing rows evaluated in one forward.

fixed_ssd_streaming_prompt_processing_ch.description: Prompt-processing rows evaluated in one forward while sparse experts stream from storage. Independent of the resident chunk. Persistent-cache publication may still clamp each forward to the next durable block boundary.

full_attention_key_value_growth_tokens.description: Append-only attention capacity added by each storage growth operation.

speculative_prefill_draft_forward_tokens.description: Maximum prompt rows evaluated by one speculative drafter forward.

prefill_graph_submission_layer_interval.description: Decoder-layer interval between multi-token prefill graph submissions while sparse experts are fully resident; zero keeps one lazy tape per chunk.

experimental_ssd_paging_prefill_graph_su.description: Experimental decoder-layer interval between multi-token prefill graph submissions while sparse experts stream from SSD; zero keeps one lazy tape per chunk.

experimental_ssd_paging_generation_graph.description: Experimental one-token submission interval used only while sparse experts stream from SSD.

prompt_cache_block_tokens.description: Exact persistent-cache block length, or null for model-derived sizing.

prompt_cache_common_prefix_stride_blocks.description: Cache-block interval between retained common-prefix restart checkpoints.

model.description: Optional policy for one canonical discovered model identity.

maximum_context_tokens.description: Optional operational ceiling that cannot exceed the discovered artifact context.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature used only when a request omits temperature.

top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling probability used only when a request omits top_p.

maximum_output_tokens.description: Output-token default used only when a request omits its output limit.

speculative_prefill.description: Explicit draft-assisted prefill relationship for the containing target model.

draft_model_id.description: Canonical discovered identity of the compatible draft model.

keep_percentage.description: Percentage of scored prompt tokens retained for target prefill.

minimum_prompt_tokens.description: Minimum prompt length eligible for speculative prefill.

mtp.description: Optional multi-token prediction preference for the containing target model.

enabled.description: When true, this model may use compatible multi-token prediction tensors. Omission stays target-only so decode does not regress until the user opts in.

draft_depth.description: Optional proposal depth; omission selects validated artifact policy.

diagnostics.description: Bounded diagnostics policy shared by Astronomical processes.

performance_attribution_enabled.description: Whether critical-path operations emit detailed performance attribution.

completion_attribution_enabled.description: Whether completed chat generations record emitted tool-call names and bounded arguments.

log_level.description: Minimum diagnostic verbosity retained in process logs.

retained_log_files.description: Positive number of hourly files retained per process.
